projects.name: LaunchYourLLM - DBMS
projects.description: A Context Management System for Running LLMS Locally on device using LMStudio. Uses MySQL Database to manage Different Context Windows or "chats" with a credit based Multi-User Management system which can be deployed to the whole world or in a private controlled environment.
numerical data: Supports over 100+ Unique LLMs that you can deploy.
improves the efficiency of token usage by a huge 50% margin.

projects.name: Graxy - CUDA
projects.description: A real-time GPU-accelerated math function visualizer in C++/CUDA parallelizing computation across 777,600 pixels (1080x720) using 256 CUDA threads per block (16x16), with an ImGui overlay for live control.
numerical data: Around 85% Faster then direct CPU Rendering according to my tests.

projects.name: Beep Boop - Agentic AI
projects.description: Flutter Application that takes Voice Commands and uses Natural Language Processing to classify and act accordingly. Uses a Locally running Tensorflow Model trained on a Fully Custom Dataset of over 10,000 commands ranging from "Set an alarm" to "Add 100 and 40" and many more.
numerical data: Made a fully custom dataset of 10,000+ commands to train the model

projects.name: Blue Ribbon - App Development

numerical data: Improved Reading accuracy for Dislexic People by 70%
